name: grossman
description: an open source alternative to postman written in electron

scripts.start: tsc -b && vite build && tsc --project src/electron/tsconfig.json && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && npx electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && npx electron-builder --linux --x64

author: Im-Stivik
